mn125:31.3: ‘If a youthful royal bull elephant passes away untamed and untrained, they’re reckoned a youthful royal bull elephant who passed away untamed;
mn125:31.6: ‘In the same way, if a junior mendicant passes away without having ended the defilements, they’re reckoned a junior mendicant who passed away untamed.
mn125:32.2: Even a middle aged royal bull elephant …
mn125:32.3: ‘If a youthful royal bull elephant passes away tamed and trained, they’re reckoned a youthful royal bull elephant who passed away tamed;
mn125:32.6: ‘In the same way, if a junior mendicant passes away having ended the defilements, they’re reckoned a junior mendicant who passed away tamed.”
